text:
elaine: quick note 6: product keeps reporting 'billing spike' when we run v2 canaries. console double-counts fallback events.
mike: we currently emit handshake, decision, response. some consumers index handshake.
elaine: proposal: emit single `served_variant` on final response for billing consumers; keep handshake/decision with `debug=true`.
ingest-bot: caution: reindexing historical data expensive. prefer additive change: new column `served_variant_flat` mapped from served_variant.
console-pm: console needs accurate per-route billed tokens + fallback % and an "estimate impact" preview. We can mock now and swap to real numbers when telemetry stabilizes.
mike: sampling: adaptive rule: tenant_qps < 10rps => 100% handshakes; else 1% deterministic by hash(tenant+rollout).
elaine: action items: router emit served_variant (mike), ingestion map to billing column and filter debug for billing (ingest-bot), console mock + toggle (console-pm).
ingest-bot: I'll create staging job to compare canonical vs legacy totals for 48h and report deltas.
